kit: HackUTD 2026 CC0 scenery kit for a West Texas (Permian Basin) produced-water field at night

models.author: James Ray Cock, Jenelle van Heerden
models.notes: Stand-in for honey mesquite. Searsia burchellii (an arid-scrub shrub), small variant, scaled up to 2.6 m tall. Leaf cards thinned and enlarged to fit the triangle budget. Leaves use alpha MASK.

models.author: Rico Cilliers
models.notes: Stand-in for creosote bush: a sparse, dry, twiggy shrub at its scanned size (about 1.7 m tall). Alpha MASK foliage.

models.author: Rico Cilliers
models.notes: Second creosote stand-in, wider and lower (about 2.2 m wide, 1.2 m tall). Alpha MASK foliage.

models.author: James Ray Cock, Jenelle van Heerden
models.notes: Stand-in for sage or saltbush. Wild rooibos bush (variant a), scaled to 0.9 m tall. Leaf cards thinned to fit the budget. Alpha MASK foliage.

models.author: James Ray Cock, Jenelle van Heerden
models.notes: Smaller sage or saltbush stand-in. Wild rooibos bush (variant b), scaled to 0.75 m tall. Alpha MASK foliage.

models.author: Rico Cilliers
models.notes: Dry grass or weed tuft. Shrub 02 (variant d) scaled down to 0.55 m tall and thinned to 3,000 triangles for scattering. Alpha MASK.

models.author: Kenney
models.notes: Very cheap low-poly grass clump (grass_large) for mass scatter, recolored from green to dry straw and scaled to 0.45 m tall. Flat color, no textures.

models.author: Rico Cilliers
models.notes: Fallen dead branch (variant a), about 1.3 m long, decimated to 2,500 triangles.

models.author: Rico Cilliers
models.notes: Fallen dead branch (variant b), about 1 m long, decimated to 2,500 triangles.

models.author: Rico Cilliers, Greg Zaal, Jenelle van Heerden
models.notes: Pale rock that reads as caliche or limestone. Scanned at 0.25 m and scaled up to 0.9 m across.

models.author: Greg Zaal, Jenelle van Heerden, Rico Cilliers
models.notes: Small pale rock. Scanned at 9 cm and scaled up to 0.6 m across, decimated to 3,000 triangles.

models.author: Greg Zaal, Jenelle van Heerden
models.notes: Tan arid-country boulder (piece a), scaled to 1.2 m across and decimated to 5,000 triangles. Textures at 512 px.

models.author: Greg Zaal, Jenelle van Heerden
models.notes: Flatter tan boulder (piece b), scaled to 1.5 m across and decimated to 5,000 triangles. Textures at 512 px.

models.author: Kenney
models.notes: Wooden post-and-rail fence section, scaled 3.4x to about 3.4 m long and 1.2 m tall. Tiles end to end along X. No barbed wire (see gaps).

models.author: Kenney
models.notes: Matching wooden fence section with a swing gate, same 3.4x scale as fence_rail_1, for a lease entrance.

models.author: Serhii Khromov
models.notes: Blue steel 55-gallon drum at real size (0.93 m tall).

models.author: MP
models.notes: Old worn tire at real size (0.6 m), standing upright. Lay it flat for yard clutter.

models.author: Kenney
models.notes: White flatbed pickup (truck-flat), low poly and stylized, scaled to 2.1 m tall. Its cartoon proportions make it about 4.4 m long and 2.4 m wide. Body and wheels joined into one mesh.

models.author: Kenney
models.notes: Wooden board on a post, scaled to 1.6 m tall. Use as a lease or road sign. The board is blank, so lease text can go on top as a decal or a label object.

models.author: Kenney
models.notes: Shipping container (conex box), the usual storage shed on a lease. Scaled to a 20 ft container (6.06 m long).

textures.name: ground_dry_soil
textures.author: Rob Tuytel
textures.notes: Main ground at 2K: dry tan soil with scattered pebbles. One tile covers 4 m x 4 m. Normal map uses the OpenGL convention (Blender and three.js).

textures.name: ground_caliche
textures.author: Charlotte Baglioni
textures.notes: Pale, packed sandy gravel that reads as caliche, for pads and lease roads. One tile covers 2.1 m x 2.1 m.

textures.name: gravel_pad
textures.author: Jenelle van Heerden, Matterfield
textures.notes: Tan crushed gravel for tank pads. One tile covers 2.25 m x 2.25 m.

textures.name: dirt_road_tracks
textures.author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
textures.notes: Smooth dirt with tire tracks (ambientCG Ground017) for the lease road. ambientCG lists no physical tile size.

hdris.author: Greg Zaal
hdris.notes: 2K (2048 x 1024) night HDRI over open arid desert with a bright moon, stars, and the Milky Way. Good for Blender world lighting with a strong moon key light.

gaps.item: Barbed wire ranch fence (posts with wire strands)
gaps.reason: No CC0 model on Poly Haven, ambientCG, or Kenney. The kit has a wooden post-and-rail fence instead. Wire strands are easy to generate in the scenery script as thin curves between posts.
No CC0 model on Poly Haven, ambientCG, or Kenney. Kenney's cactus is a saguaro shape that does not grow in Texas, so it was left out.
No CC0 model found on the allowed sources.
No CC0 model found on the allowed sources.
Its packs download through a Google Drive folder, not a direct link, so they were left out under the direct-download, no-login rule.
